title: Protesters against the white train and the Nevada test site

tellings.quote: most of my time is fought against protesters trying to wipe out the white train or go to the nuclear site in in Nevada.

plain: John S. Herrington, who served as US Secretary of Energy in the 1980s, tells Michels that most of his time in that job was spent dealing with protesters. He says they tried to stop "the white train", the train that carried nuclear weapons, or to get onto the nuclear test site in Nevada. He offers it as his own memory of what the job was really like day to day.
